title: NVScene 2015 Session: How to Create Content with Signed Distance Functions (Johann Korndörfer)
summary: Johann Korndorfer's NVScene 2015 talk on building content with signed distance functions. It focuses on patterns that make SDF modelling more structured, arguing that SDFs capture a shape's essence like vector graphics do compared with polygons or voxels.
why: Recommended as an excellent talk from a demoscene practitioner on how to build sophisticated scenes from distance functions.

quote.text: this is an excellent talk on the subject
